content.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
content.subheading: Everything you need to know about farm investments, crop insurance, and harvest dividend distributions.

questions.question: What is the minimum amount required to start investing?
questions.answer: You can start investing with as little as $250 in our micro-greenhouse and poultry pools. Higher capital pools such as permanent avocado orchards require a $1,000 minimum ticket.

questions.question: How are farm investments protected against climate risk?
questions.answer: All partner farms carry comprehensive multi-peril crop insurance policies underwritten by top-tier agricultural insurers, protecting 100% of investor capital against drought, flood, pests, and frost.

questions.question: When and how are investment returns paid out?
questions.answer: Yields are calculated throughout the growing season and distributed upon harvest completion or quarterly depending on pool terms. Funds are credited directly to your FarmVest wallet.

questions.question: How does FarmVest verify and select participating farms?
questions.answer: Our agronomy review team conducts on-site soil assays, water rights audits, financial background checks, and historical yield reviews. Only the top 4% of applicant farms pass diligence.
